statements.quote: We had suggested for high single-digit growth versus this quarter, we have done almost 11% kind of a growth.
statements.target: Maintain high single-digit revenue growth guidance for FY27.

statements.quote: Gross margin was at 80.5% for the quarter, higher than the same period last year.
statements.target: Maintain gross margin around 80% for FY27.

statements.quote: EBITDA margins came in at 28.9% while EBITDA margins were slightly lower, please note that Q1 FY26 had some benefit from Lenalidomide sales.
statements.target: Keep EBITDA margin near 29% for FY27.

statements.quote: We continue to invest in building an R&D pipeline for both global generics and innovative medicine businesses. Consolidated investments towards R&D for Q1 FY27 stands at INR8,264 million or 5.4% of sales.
statements.target: Spend ~5.4% of sales on R&D in FY27.

statements.quote: In Q1 FY27, our innovative medicine sales were up 12.8% to reach USD351 million. This business accounted for 21.9% of Sun sales for the quarter.
statements.target: Innovative medicine sales growth >12% and represent ~22% of total sales FY27.

statements.quote: During the quarter, the company became number 2 generic semaglutide injectable player.
statements.target: Position as top 2 generic semaglutide injectable seller by FY27.

statements.quote: Balance sheet of Sun continues to be strong with a net cash of $3.4 billion at the consolidated level.
statements.target: Maintain net cash balance of ~$3.4bn FY27.

statements.quote: Effective tax rate for the quarter was at 27.8% versus 24.3% in Q1 FY26.
statements.target: Maintain effective tax rate ~27-28% until Organon transaction completes.

analyst_pushback: Queried about exact capex split between generics and innovatives
Sought clarification on future semaglutide launch timelines
